_comment: Setup + configuration reference for this capture, added retrospectively (2026-06-26) for future reference. Values are grounded in this folder's README.md / mag-analysis.md and the session's active config — not inferred. This was a SENSOR capture (disarmed hand rotation), so no control loop / PID was exercised; pid is null by design.
capture_type: magnetometer spread / hard-iron spot-check (hand rotation through all orientations)

hardware.airframe: X-quad (same build as the 2026-06-25 pitch sessions); board hand-held for the rotation
hardware.imu: BMX160 (accel/gyro/mag); mag is the device under test here
hardware.motor_geometry: N/A — motors disarmed/off for this capture

firmware.rate_controller_algo: PID cascade (RATE_CTRL_PID). INDI (firmware/src/control/rate_indi.c) did not exist until 2026-06-26 — it was NOT running here.
firmware.calibration_in_effect: IMU/mag calibration from 20260625-032526-imu-calib-verify (this run verifies it from a fresh capture)

pid_note: No PID/control loop active — disarmed magnetometer capture. Documented here so a future reader does not look for gains that were never exercised.

capture_params.columns: t,ax,ay,az,gx,gy,gz,mx,my,mz,temp (accel m/s^2, gyro dps, mag uT, temp C)
capture_params.reconstruction: ImuRaw keyframes (~1.7 Hz) + ImuCompressed f16 deltas, resampled to 50 Hz by the sniffer recorder

headline: Mag stays heading-grade: ||m|| mean 40.5 uT at CoV 4.95 %, LS-sphere hard-iron residual 0.41 uT (centred on origin). No re-calibration needed.

result_metrics.sample_mean_offset_note: coverage bias, not a fault — judge centring by the LS-sphere fit, not the sample mean
